summary: Hardened the verdict.mjs classifier to require explicit evidence.source buffer/string and evidence.holdout capture with successful exit code and confirmation line. Validated source SHA-256 must match the finalSourceSha256 claim in the report. CLI augmentations added to load source and holdout-result.json. Fixed candidate.persistedCandidate check and re-validated test passing for all cases including missing evidence rejection and exitCode validation from captures, not report metadata.
limitations: Does not check candidate file contents beyond SHA-256 match in stdout logs.
No handling of multiple evidence sources or dynamic evidence arrays.
CLI does not recover from existing verdict.json evidence files.
